notes: Alumni Green: no ground of its own. The plaza (adopted from the main model and corrected, adopt.json) replaces the main model's plaza mesh; nothing else of the green (lawn, walks, the WS3 paving, beds, trees, buildings, lamps) is taken out. In the published tiles the mesh WS5_Cole_plaza_circle holds only that object's three materials (pavers, brick edge course, band; checked in a dump of t_-1_-1), so it is dropped by name.
